name: What should I ask before hiring a luxury pool builder?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a pool contractor before starting a high-end custom pool project?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a pool contractor before starting a high-end custom pool project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a luxury pool builder, focus on experience, process, and transparency. Ask to see completed projects similar to yours, especially if your site is sloped, compact, or highly customized. Confirm who handles design coordination, engineering, permits, inspections, and scheduling, because those responsibilities can make or break a project. Request a detailed proposal that lists what is included and excluded, including finishes, lighting, automation, coping, decking, and cleanup. It also helps to ask about change orders, warranty coverage, subcontractor coordination, and how the builder handles unexpected site conditions. Luxury pool projects are too detailed for vague quotes. A strong contractor should be able to explain the construction sequence and provide realistic timelines and budget assumptions. The best choice is usually the builder who gives the clearest plan, not just the lowest number.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar completed projects, permit experience, engineering coordination, schedule, warranty coverage, equipment brands, and who manages communication during construction. You should also ask for a detailed scope so you can compare bids accurately.
